_doc: MKK costs and income per year, in Ft, for the budget slide charts (src/charts.py). Costs: xcontest (XContest fee), kupak (cups, medals, gift cards). Income: siresz (SIRESZ Sportalap, total, before 2022), siresz_cel (SIRESZ Sportalap céltámogatás: the pilots' voluntary MKK payments), siresz_alt (SIRESZ Sportalap general, covers the rest), hffa, sarkany (Sárkányrepülésért Alapítvány). Every value is verified unless its key is in 'estimate' (computed from an invoice or prices), 'digitized' (read off the old 2025 chart image) or 'derived' (siresz_alt = costs minus the other income; computed by charts.py, not stored). 'hatch': keys drawn hatched on the charts (not final). Server costs (starthelyek.hu) and SVB fuel are not MKK costs (user, 2026-11-20).
